children: Pilgrim’s Pride secured a proposed $31 million cash settlement from JBS to resolve a stockholder derivative and class action.
The parties entered a Stipulation on Aug. 4, 2026 to settle the derivative and class action for $31,000,000 in cash to the company.
The settlement resolves claims related to the Charter Amendment and Tax Sharing Agreement and releases all claims if approved by the Delaware Court of Chancery.
JBS will deposit $250,000 to cover notice costs and $30,750,000 into an escrow controlled by Pilgrim’s Pride; net funds (less fees, taxes, notice costs) transfer to the company after effectiveness.
Plaintiffs’ counsel will seek up to $4,805,000 in attorneys’ fees and expenses to be paid from the settlement fund; stockholders are not personally liable.
The Court scheduled a final fairness hearing for Nov. 20, 2026; class members won’t receive direct payments—the recovery goes to the company.

title: Pilgrim’s Pride reaches $31M settlement with JBS over derivative lawsuit
